feeds.title: A Couple Cooks
feeds.description: Hundreds of healthy vegetarian, vegan, and whole food recipes brought to you by Sonja and Alex Overhiser, a couple who loves to cook.

feeds.title: Indy Pizza Blog
feeds.description: What's the best pizza in Indianapolis? Chris and Eric share their passion for pizza in the Indy Pizza Blog, including photos, reviews, favorites, and stories.

feeds.title: Visit Columbus Indiana » Eat & Drink
feeds.description: This section features articles on food and drink. The Columbus Area Visitors Center has information on architecture tours, attractions, and dining option in the Columbus area.

feeds.title: Blue Tree Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Recipes, tips, & more. Valerie Polley is a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist serving the Greater Carmel, Indiana area. Specializing in gut health, gastrointestinal issues, Celiac disease, SIBO, IBS and autoimmune conditions. Specializes in the FODMAP elimination diet.

feeds.title: Indianapolis Restaurant Scene
feeds.description: Erin started this blog for sharing her personal, honest, and unbiased take on the restaurant scene in Indiana. She moved 'back home again' to Indiana in the summer of 2006 after spending many years in San Francisco (and a couple in England).

feeds.title: Indiana Grown Blog
feeds.description: Indiana Grown is a grassroots movement to encourage Hoosiers to buy, sell, and share food and products made right here in Indiana. They create connections between farmers and consumers by promoting all forms of agriculture that are packaged, raised, processed, and grown within the state of Indiana.

feeds.title: This Mama Cooks! On a Diet
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Anne-Marie Nichols. I've been a Gluten Free Recipes Development Writer and Photographer at This Mama Cooks! and a Social Media Consultant for the past 15+ years. Helping you with quick, easy, gluten-free, dairy-free, Keto, vegan, vegetarian & low carb recipes.

feeds.title: Fort Wayne Food Tours Blog
feeds.description: The blog includes discounts, historical tidbits, and highlights from our culinary partners! A Fort Wayne Food Tour is the ideal way to experience a variety of tastings while highlighting noteworthy architecture and interesting historical insights.

feeds.title: FoodLoveTog
feeds.description: I'm Candace. I'm a Mid-Western born and raised home cook that loves to eat! Food is my love language and sharing it with you combines the two. I love to make family recipes and cultivate new flavors. I'm passionate about delicious meals, food access, and getting people comfortable in the kitchen.

feeds.title: India from Indiana
feeds.description: Hi, I'm India! I make gluten free recipes with a focus on healthy, fresh, and real food ingredients. If you're looking for me, you'll likely find me making a mess in our tiny kitchen, playing fetch with our dog, or renovating our 1918 craftsman home.

feeds.title: Northeast Indiana Local Food Network Blog
feeds.description: Local Food for Thought is a blog by Northeast Indiana Local Food Network to highlight our local food community. The Northeast Indiana Local Food Network works to enhance the quality of place of Northeast Indiana by promoting local food culture in the region and supporting local food entrepreneurship.

feeds.title: Indianapolis Monthly » Food & Drinks
feeds.description: This section features articles on Food and Drinks. Indianapolis Monthly, the city's authoritative general interest magazine, provides its loyal monthly readers with compelling narrative stories and smart, lively service pieces.

feeds.title: Tara Rochford Nutrition » Recipes
feeds.description: Tara, a registered dietitian nutritionist, healthy lifestyle blogger, and certified personal & group fitness instructor shares healthy recipes for all seasons, nutrition tips, workouts, healthy living tips, and more.
